user.title: Connect PVM
user.description: Enter the address of the PVM backend API. Use the scheme-less form to save typing, e.g. homeassistant.local:7000 or host.docker.internal:7000 (Docker). The PVM API token is stored in Home Assistant only.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate PVM
reauth_confirm.description: The PVM backend rejected the stored token. Enter a new PVM API token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the PVM backend. Check that the backend is running and that the URL/port are correct (in Docker use host.docker.internal, not localhost).
error.invalid_auth: The PVM backend rejected the API token. Enter the PVM_API_SECRET configured on the server.

set_device_state.name: Set device state
set_device_state.description: Set a PVM-managed device's on/off state via the PVM backend.

state.name: State
state.description: Target state (on/off, true/false or a device-specific value).

set_device_power.name: Set device power
set_device_power.description: Set a PVM-managed device's power setpoint in watts.

set_device_temperature.name: Set device temperature
set_device_temperature.description: Set a PVM-managed device's temperature setpoint in °C.

update_plan.name: Update load plan
update_plan.description: Push a load plan to the PVM backend.

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Return the latest PVM residual-power forecast.

get_history.name: Get device history
get_history.description: Return recorded history for a PVM-managed device.

start.name: Start
start.description: Optional ISO timestamp for the start of the window.

end.name: End
end.description: Optional ISO timestamp for the end of the window.

get_calendar_events.name: Get calendar events
get_calendar_events.description: Return calendar events known to PVM.

get_sensors.name: Get sensors
get_sensors.description: Return Home Assistant sensor states known to PVM.

get_entities.name: Get entities
get_entities.description: Return the Home Assistant entity registry known to PVM.

get_devices.name: Get devices
get_devices.description: Return the devices managed by PVM.

detect_ha_url.name: Detect Home Assistant URL
detect_ha_url.description: Push this Home Assistant instance's base URL(s) to the PVM backend so the PVM setup assistant can find Home Assistant automatically.
